## Checklist

- [ ] No client data, patient data, credentials or analytics exports (SECURITY.md)
- [ ] Any examples are anonymised (examples/README.md)
- [ ] Does not reopen a locked higher-level decision without new evidence
- [ ] Definition of Done updated if completion criteria changed (`ops/stages.yaml`)
- [ ] `python3 scripts/build.py` run; regenerated stage cards committed
- [ ] Prompt IDs, stage folder names and headings unchanged, or the operational-tool links have been updated
- [ ] CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]` updated (material changes)
